crossRefs.note: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
My son, don’t forget my teaching; but let your heart keep my commandments:
Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.
He who robs his father and drives away his mother, is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.
Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his…
But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’
For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts…
They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, blaspheming.

translations.web: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.
translations.bsb: A discerning son keeps the law, but a companion of gluttons disgraces his father.
translations.kjv: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.
translations.asv: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son; But he that is a companion of gluttons shameth his father.
